nativeCheck.testName: toggles native checked state in both directions

CBX-001.remaining: Map the additional existing defaults/root-prop assertions and ingest the existing compiler/type result; no native duplicate is inherently required.

CBX-002.observed: Uncontrolled unchecked -> checked -> unchecked through physical clicks.
CBX-002.remaining: Map the additional existing JS controlled/uncontrolled press and callback-count assertions, including defaultStatus precedence; native duplication is not required for state logic.

CBX-003.remaining: Map the additional existing anatomy/order, text-gating and warning assertions and native wrapping cases; rendered geometry needs layout evidence.

CBX-004.observed: Native checkbox role (not the complete accessibility requirement).
CBX-004.remaining: Map the additional existing inner-node and JS semantics assertions and native naming cases; actual native action dispatch needs platform evidence when claimed.

CBX-005.remaining: Map the additional existing secondary-text/state, interaction/status and caller-style assertions; resolved styles can be established by unit tests.

CBX-006.remaining: Win32 focus modality, disabled/detached targets, and dual-ring geometry; collect focus/visual evidence.
